# Testing Strategy
<!-- docs.AI knowledge doc — auto-generated by speckit.init -->

## TDD Skill (`ai-radija-tdd`)

The primary testing mechanism is the `ai-radija-tdd` skill, which enforces a strict Red-Green-Refactor loop:

1. **RED** — Write one failing test that describes the desired behavior
2. **GREEN** — Write the minimal code to make that test pass
3. **REFACTOR** — Improve code structure without breaking tests
4. Repeat until all acceptance criteria are covered

### Core Rules

- Test one behavior per cycle — no batch test writing
- Test via the **public interface only** — never test internal implementation details
- Tasks are **vertical slices** (DB → logic → API → UI), not horizontal layers
- A test plan is created before any code is written per cycle

### Stack Auto-Detection

The TDD skill inspects project files to select the correct framework:

| Language / Stack | Test Framework |
|-----------------|---------------|
| .NET / C# | xUnit + FluentAssertions |
| Node.js / TypeScript | Jest or Vitest (auto-detected) |
| Python | pytest |
| Rust | cargo test |
| Go | go test + testify |
| Java / Kotlin | JUnit + Mockito |
| Ruby | RSpec or Minitest |

Detection heuristic: look for `*.csproj`, `package.json`, `Cargo.toml`, `go.mod`, `pom.xml`, `Gemfile` at project root.

## Azure DevOps Test Integration

When the tracker is Azure DevOps, the TDD skill:
- Creates **Test Case** work items for each acceptance criterion
- Maps Given/When/Then format to ADO test step format
- Links test cases to the parent PBI

---

## Requirements Quality Checks (`ai-radija-checklist`)

Separate from implementation tests, this skill validates requirement quality:
- Completeness (every story has AC)
- Clarity (no ambiguous terms)
- Consistency (no contradicting statements)
- Measurability (AC are verifiable)

Output: `checklists/<name>.md` with pass/fail items.

---

## Coverage Targets (Radija)

For projects bootstrapped with `ai-radija-bootstrap`:

| Framework | Target |
|-----------|--------|
| xUnit (.NET) | 70% |
| Jasmine / Jest | 60% |

These are minimums; teams may set higher targets in their constitution.

## Test Types

| Type | Scope | Who writes it |
|------|-------|--------------|
| **Unit** | Single function/class | Developer (via TDD skill) |
| **Integration** | Multiple layers (e.g. API → DB) | Developer (via TDD skill) |
| **E2E** | Full user journey | Developer (via TDD skill, optional) |
| **Requirements quality** | Spec document | AI agent (via checklist skill) |
